\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{2 y^{3}}{x^{2} y + x y^{2}}.
$$

If the transformation $y=v(x)x$ is applied to the differential equation, what is the resulting equation?

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{2 y^{3}}{x^{2} y + x y^{2}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =\frac{2 v^{3} x^{3}}{v^{2} x^{3} + v x^{3}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =\frac{2 v^{2}}{v + 1} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{2 v^{2}}{v + 1} - v \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{v^{2} - v}{v + 1} \\ \left(\frac{v + 1}{v^{2} - v}\right)\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$
